decisions.description: Horseback riding is included in the retreat programme
Museum visits are included, including in the capital
A private chef will be brought in at the accommodation to teach the group to cook classic Mexican food
Attendees may bring a spouse or significant other, or a parent if they have none
Children are not coming on the retreat
No theme-park stop will be added to the Florida layover; it stays a single night near the airport

actions.description: Talk to the chef about what he can put on the menu, including the foods people asked for

notes: The retreat itself, the Mexico location and the Florida layover are presented by Jenny as already planned, so they are not decisions this case makes -- the same reading applied to the finance briefings in tiron-TS3003a-c01 and tiron-ES2004a-c01. What IS decided here is everything settled in response to a question from the room: horseback riding, museums, the chef, spouses, children, and the rejected Disney stop. A rejection is a decision; 'no' settles the matter as much as 'yes'. The chef action keeps owner null because 'we will talk to the chef' is literally plural -- Jenny is the obvious owner, which is exactly why guessing her would be a guess.
